description: Authentication UI: Create registration and login pages with Material Design 3, Arabic RTL support, form validation, loading states, and error handling in Arabic. Create reusable form widgets. This feature depends on FEAT-002 (providers must exist).
steps: Create d:\higo\lib\widgets\custom_text_field.dart - reusable TextField widget with Arabic label, validation, and RTL support using const constructor where possible
Create d:\higo\lib\widgets\custom_button.dart - reusable ElevatedButton with loading indicator using const constructor
Create d:\higo\lib\widgets\loading_overlay.dart - full-screen loading indicator widget

Create d:\higo\lib\pages\auth\register_page.dart with email and password fields, validation using validators.dart, integration with auth_provider for registration, Arabic error messages from constants.dart, and proper loading/error states

Create d:\higo\lib\pages\auth\login_page.dart with email and password fields, validation, integration with auth_provider for login, remember me option cached with cache_service, Arabic UI and error messages, proper loading/error states
Create d:\higo\lib\pages\auth\auth_wrapper.dart - decides whether to show auth pages or chat list based on auth state from auth_provider
acceptance_criteria: Registration page validates email format and password strength with Arabic error messages
Login page caches user credentials when 'remember me' is checked
Both pages show loading overlay during authentication
Error messages from Firebase are displayed in Arabic
RTL layout works correctly for Arabic text
All widgets use const constructors where possible for performance
findings: All acceptance criteria met. Created reusable widgets (custom_text_field, custom_button, loading_overlay) with const constructors where possible. Implemented register_page and login_page with Arabic RTL support, form validation, loading states, and Firebase error handling. Created auth_wrapper to route based on auth state. Updated main.dart to use ProviderScope and AuthWrapper. All widgets properly handle loading and error states. Tests updated to test form validators. flutter analyze shows no errors, all tests pass.
